decisions.reason: After four seasons and no observed website presence since 2019, this niche harvesting crate appears to have revealed limited commercial value, so the option is no longer worth keeping open despite its initial strategic symbolism.

A multi-model foldable large-container line is close to the firm's core reusable-packaging business, so even with weak recent visibility it remains strategic and relatively inexpensive to keep available.

This stackable crate line fits the firm's standard capabilities and customer base and is likely low-cost to maintain, so management would still keep the option open although the lack of recent visibility raises risk.

Spill-retention pallets are a more adjacent niche, and two years without observable market presence suggest the market test has largely run its course, making redeployment of resources the better choice.
